def final_code(summary, outcome):
    """G1/G5/A3: summary is PROVISIONAL. closeout.json binds its completed publication, final ledger and owner
    inventory. Neither file certifies itself: parent observed runner exit + pinned closeout + raw audit are REQUIRED.
    Any uncertain owner/census/publication/resource retains parent block; no waits/traversals after UNSETTLED
    beyond separately bounded runner-metadata work. Safety overrides candidate/control while preserving candidate info."""
    out_dir = STATE["out"]
    host_end = clock()
    previous_end = STATE.get("cleanup_deadline")
    STATE["cleanup_deadline"] = min(time.monotonic() + SETTLE, STATE["mono_end"] + SETTLE)
    defects = []
    try:
        for b in LIVE_BUFFERS:
            if b.release_requested and not b.released:
                b.release()                      # no join; a live collector keeps its ownership
        try:
            outstanding = buffer_charge()
            unresolved = unresolved_inventory()
        except BaseException as exc:
            outstanding = None
            unresolved = [{"kind": "unknown resource accounting", "error": repr(exc)}]
        if outstanding is None or type(outstanding) is not int or outstanding != 0:
            defects.append("proof RAM accounting not affirmatively zero")
        children = [c.settled_rec for c in OWNED if c.proc is not None]
        all_settled = all(not receipt_resource_contradictions(r) for r in children)
        helpers_settled = all(h.settled is True for h in HELPERS if h.proc is not None)
        if not all_settled or not helpers_settled:
            defects.append("owned settlement unproven")
        if host_end is None and not cancelled() and not LATCH:
            defects.append("required closeout host clock unavailable")
        try:
            defects += confinement_refusals() + preservation_refusals()
            tree_usage = disk_usage(out_dir)
            tree_bytes = tree_usage["enforced_max_bytes"]
            if type(tree_bytes) is not int or tree_bytes < 0:
                raise RuntimeError("retained output usage is not an exact nonnegative integer")
            if tree_bytes > STATE["reservation"]:
                defects.append("retained output max(logical, allocated) exceeds full reservation")
            led_why, ledger = ledger_refusals()
            defects += led_why
        except BaseException as exc:
            tree_usage, tree_bytes, ledger = None, None, None
            defects.append("closeout census/ledger unproved %r" % (exc,))
            unresolved.append({"kind": "unknown census/resource", "error": repr(exc)})
        m, e = time.monotonic(), time.time()
        late = m > STATE["mono_end"] + SETTLE or e > STATE["abs_end"] + SETTLE \
               or m - STATE["mono0"] > MAX_CHUNK
        if late:
            defects.append("closeout observations outside frozen bounds")
        if unresolved:
            defects.append("unproven owners/resources/publications retain parent block")
        for w in defects:
            latch("closeout: " + w)
        boundary = next(ORDER)
        co = STATE["cancel_order"]            # N9 AFTER boundary
        code = choose_exit_code(outcome, unresolved, co is not None and co < boundary)
        runner = STATE["runner_identity"]
        ownership = {"runner": runner, "runner_resources": "threads, descriptors, all RAM until runner exit",
                     "children": [{"pid": c.pid, "pgid": c.pgid, "identity_at_start": c.identity_at_start,
                                   "started_by_epoch": c.started_epoch, "actual_owned_reap": c.reaped,
                                   "wait_lost": c.wait_lost, "known_identities": list(c.known_identities.values()),
                                   "live_census": c.last_census, "census_uncertainty": c.census_uncertainty}
                                  for c in OWNED if c.proc is not None],
                     "helpers": list(HELPER_LOG), "unresolved": unresolved}
        summary.update(schema=SUMMARY_SCHEMA, publication_authority="PROVISIONAL until closeout + parent exit/raw audit",
                       proposed_exit_code=code, exit_code=code, host_clock_end=host_end, children=children,
                       all_children_settled=all_settled, all_helpers_settled=helpers_settled,
                       metadata_helpers=list(HELPER_LOG), ownership_manifest=ownership, unsettled_owners=unresolved,
                       reservation_retained=True, parent_block=bool(unresolved or defects or LATCH or ledger is None),
                       release_requires="NEW parent disposition after runner exit, complete liveness/resource/publication audit",
                       proof_ram_accounting_valid=type(outstanding) is int, proof_ram_outstanding_bytes=outstanding,
                       quarantine_receipts=[c.quarantine_path for c in list(OWNED) + list(HELPERS) if c.quarantined],
                       latch=list(LATCH), cancel_order=co, closeout_boundary=boundary,
                       cancel_before_closeout=co is not None and co < boundary,
                       candidate_observed=bool(outcome.get("sat")), run_tree_usage_before_summary=tree_usage,
                       run_tree_enforced_bytes_before_summary=tree_bytes,
                       lane_ledger_before_summary=ledger, closeout_defects=defects,
                       retained_capacity_charged=STATE["written"], full_parent_reservation=STATE["reservation"],
                       chunk_claim="held" if not late and not unresolved else "voided")
        summary_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "summary.json")
        try:
            summary_sha, summary_bytes = write_bytes_x(summary_path, serialize(summary))
        except BaseException as exc:
            print("SUMMARY PUBLICATION FAILED", repr(exc), flush=True)
            return EXIT_SAFETY_STOP
        # A parseable pre-publication summary cannot promote anything. Observe completion and reconcile roots NOW.
        after_summary = {"mono": time.monotonic(), "epoch": time.time()}
        if after_summary["mono"] > STATE["mono_end"] + SETTLE or after_summary["epoch"] > STATE["abs_end"] + SETTLE:
            latch("summary publication observed beyond frozen bounds")
            defects.append("late summary publication")
        try:
            led_why, final_ledger = ledger_refusals()
            defects += led_why + confinement_refusals() + preservation_refusals()
            unresolved = unresolved_inventory()
        except BaseException as exc:
            final_ledger = None
            unresolved.append({"kind": "post-summary resource/census unknown", "error": repr(exc)})
            defects.append("post-summary observations unproved")
        for w in defects:
            if "closeout: " + w not in LATCH:
                latch("closeout: " + w)
        code = choose_exit_code(outcome, unresolved, cancelled())
        closeout = {"schema": CLOSEOUT_SCHEMA, "summary_sha256": summary_sha, "summary_bytes": summary_bytes,
                    "exit_code": code, "runner_identity": runner, "summary_publication_observed": after_summary,
                    "parent_block": bool(unresolved or defects or LATCH or final_ledger is None), "unresolved": unresolved,
                    "full_parent_reservation_retained_until_disposition": STATE["reservation"],
                    "final_ledger_including_summary": final_ledger, "publication_defects": defects,
                    "closeout_capacity_reserved_bytes": RECORD_MAX,
                    "post_closeout_ledger_reconciled_by_matching_actual_exit": True,
                    "host_clock_required_and_available": host_end is not None,
                    "qualified_item_publications": summary.get("commits", {}) if code == EXIT_PLAN_COMPLETE else {},
                    "authority": "only with matching parent-observed runner exit and complete raw audit",
                    "publication_completion_self_certified": False}
        try:
            closeout_sha = write_x(os.path.join(out_dir, "closeout.json"), closeout)
        except BaseException as exc:
            print("CLOSEOUT PUBLICATION FAILED", repr(exc), flush=True)
            return EXIT_SAFETY_STOP
        final_ledger_why, _post_publication_ledger = ledger_refusals()
        if final_ledger_why:
            return EXIT_SAFETY_STOP
        print("SUMMARY", summary_path, "CLOSEOUT", closeout_sha, "proposed_exit", code, flush=True)
        # LAST observation after every write/fsync/close and output. Parent compares the actual returned code.
        if time.monotonic() > STATE["mono_end"] + SETTLE or time.time() > STATE["abs_end"] + SETTLE:
            return EXIT_SAFETY_STOP
        return choose_exit_code(outcome, unresolved, cancelled())
    finally:
        STATE["cleanup_deadline"] = previous_end

class ProofBuffer:
    """Owned capped RAM collector. Timeouts bound source work and joins, not OS-call latency;
    an incomplete close or late return retains parent ownership, never a synthetic settlement."""

    def __init__(self, fifo_path, cap):
        self.fifo_path, self.cap = fifo_path, cap
        self.dir_fd = self.fifo_name = self.fifo_identity = self.fifo_ino = None
        self.blocks = []
        self.sha = None
        self.retained = self.received = self.discarded = 0
        self.over_cap = self.connected = self.eof = self.released = self.release_requested = False
        self.frozen_id = None
        self.errors = []
        self.construction_error = None
        self.unblocked_by_runner = False
        self.finished = None
        self.finish_started = False
        self.finish_deadline = None
        self.thread = None
        self.thread_started = False
        self.reader_fd = self.reader_fd_identity = None
        self.reader_fd_closed = True
        self.reader_close_attempted = False
        self.reader_close_error = None
        self.unblock_fd = self.unblock_fd_identity = None
        self.unblock_fd_closed = True
        self.unblock_close_attempted = False
        self.unblock_close_error = None
        self.unblock_open_attempts = 0
        LIVE_BUFFERS.append(self)                 # every field exists before any fallible acquisition
        try:
            self.sha = hashlib.sha256()
            self.dir_fd, self.fifo_name = tree_path(fifo_path)
            st = mkfifo_anchored(fifo_path)
            self.fifo_ino = st.st_ino
            self.fifo_identity = [st.st_dev, st.st_ino]
            self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
            self.thread.start()
            self.thread_started = True
        except BaseException as exc:
            self.construction_error = repr(exc)
            self._error("construction", exc)
            latch("proof buffer construction unproven %r" % (exc,))
            try:
                self.finish()
                self.release()
            except BaseException as cleanup_exc:
                self._error("construction rollback", cleanup_exc)
            raise

    @property
    def error(self):
        return "; ".join(self.errors) if self.errors else None

    def _error(self, what, exc):
        self.errors.append("%s: %r" % (what, exc))

    def _close_reader(self):
        if self.reader_fd is None or self.reader_close_attempted:
            return
        self.reader_close_attempted = True
        try:
            os.close(self.reader_fd)
        except BaseException as exc:
            self.reader_fd_closed = None          # outcome unknown; retained fd must never be blindly retried
            self.reader_close_error = "reader fd close: %r" % (exc,)
            self.errors.append(self.reader_close_error)
        else:
            self.reader_fd_closed = True
            self.reader_fd = None

    def _close_unblock(self):
        if self.unblock_fd is None or self.unblock_close_attempted:
            return
        self.unblock_close_attempted = True
        try:
            os.close(self.unblock_fd)
        except BaseException as exc:
            self.unblock_fd_closed = None
            self.unblock_close_error = "unblock fd close: %r" % (exc,)
            self.errors.append(self.unblock_close_error)
        else:
            self.unblock_fd_closed = True
            self.unblock_fd = None

    def _run(self):
        self.thread_started = True
        acc = None
        try:
            acc = bytearray()
            self.reader_fd = os.open(self.fifo_name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,
                                     dir_fd=self.dir_fd)          # producer or bounded finish supplies a writer
            self.reader_fd_identity = self.reader_fd
            self.reader_fd_closed = False
            fst = os.fstat(self.reader_fd)
            if not stat.S_ISFIFO(fst.st_mode) or [fst.st_dev, fst.st_ino] != self.fifo_identity:
                raise RuntimeError("collector opened a different FIFO")
            self.connected = True
            while True:
                b = os.read(self.reader_fd, FEED_BLOCK)
                if not b:
                    self.eof = True
                    break
                self.received += len(b)
                if not self.over_cap and self.retained + len(b) <= self.cap:
                    acc += b
                    self.sha.update(b)
                    self.retained += len(b)
                    while len(acc) >= FEED_BLOCK:
                        self.blocks.append(bytes(acc[:FEED_BLOCK]))
                        del acc[:FEED_BLOCK]
                else:
                    self.over_cap = True
                    self.discarded += len(b)
        except BaseException as exc:
            self._error("reader", exc)
        finally:
            self._close_reader()
            try:
                if acc:
                    self.blocks.append(bytes(acc))
            except BaseException as exc:
                self._error("tail", exc)

    def digest(self):
        """Independent second pass over retained RAM blocks."""
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        n = 0
        for b in self.blocks:
            h.update(b)
            n += len(b)
        return [h.hexdigest(), n]

    def finish(self, timeout=None):
        """One source-level bounded attempt; all endpoint/history evidence survives failure."""
        if self.finished is not None:
            return self.finished
        self.finish_started = True
        end = work_deadline(SINK_UNBLOCK + STREAM_JOIN if timeout is None else max(0.0, timeout))
        self.finish_deadline = end
        alive = None
        rec = {"fifo": self.fifo_path, "storage": "RAM only", "cap": self.cap,
               "fifo_same_inode_still_fifo": False, "buffer_rehash_matches": False,
               "finish_deadline_in_bounds": False, "sink_settled": False}
        try:
            active = lambda: self.thread is not None and self.thread.is_alive()
            alive = active()
            unblock_end = min(end, time.monotonic() + SINK_UNBLOCK)
            while alive and not self.connected and time.monotonic() < unblock_end:
                try:
                    self.unblock_open_attempts += 1
                    self.unblock_fd = os.open(self.fifo_name,
                                              os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,
                                              dir_fd=self.dir_fd)
                    self.unblock_fd_identity = self.unblock_fd
                    self.unblock_fd_closed = False
                    self.unblocked_by_runner = True
                    st = os.fstat(self.unblock_fd)
                    if not stat.S_ISFIFO(st.st_mode) or [st.st_dev, st.st_ino] != self.fifo_identity:
                        raise RuntimeError("opened unblock writer is not the retained FIFO")
                except OSError as exc:
                    if self.unblock_fd is not None or exc.errno != errno.ENXIO:
                        self._error("unblock", exc)
                        break
                    time.sleep(min(SUPERVISE_SLICE, max(0.0, unblock_end - time.monotonic())))
                except BaseException as exc:
                    self._error("unblock", exc)
                    break
                else:
                    break
                finally:
                    self._close_unblock()        # at most once for the one acquired descriptor
                alive = active()
            if self.thread is not None and self.thread.ident is not None:
                self.thread.join(max(0.0, min(STREAM_JOIN, end - time.monotonic())))
            alive = active()
            if time.monotonic() > end:
                raise RuntimeError("proof buffer cleanup allowance exhausted")
            if self.fifo_identity is not None:
                st = os.stat(self.fifo_name, dir_fd=self.dir_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
                rec["fifo_same_inode_still_fifo"] = (stat.S_ISFIFO(st.st_mode)
                                                       and [st.st_dev, st.st_ino] == self.fifo_identity)
            if not alive and self.construction_error is None:
                self.blocks = tuple(self.blocks)
                self.frozen_id = id(self.blocks)
                rec["blocks"] = len(self.blocks)
                rec["buffer_rehash"] = self.digest()
        except BaseException as exc:
            rec["finish_error"] = repr(exc)
            self._error("finish", exc)
        digest = None if self.sha is None else self.sha.hexdigest()
        rec.update(connected=self.connected, eof=self.eof, received=self.received, retained=self.retained,
                   discarded=self.discarded, over_cap=self.over_cap, error=self.error, errors=list(self.errors),
                   construction_error=self.construction_error, unblocked_by_runner=self.unblocked_by_runner,
                   thread_started=self.thread_started, thread_alive_after_join=alive,
                   reader_fd=self.reader_fd, reader_fd_identity=self.reader_fd_identity,
                   reader_fd_closed=self.reader_fd_closed, reader_close_attempted=self.reader_close_attempted,
                   reader_close_error=self.reader_close_error,
                   unblock_fd=self.unblock_fd, unblock_fd_identity=self.unblock_fd_identity,
                   unblock_fd_closed=self.unblock_fd_closed, unblock_close_attempted=self.unblock_close_attempted,
                   unblock_close_error=self.unblock_close_error, unblock_open_attempts=self.unblock_open_attempts,
                   sha256_of_retained=digest)
        rec["buffer_rehash_matches"] = rec.get("buffer_rehash") == [digest, self.retained] and digest is not None
        rec["finish_deadline_in_bounds"] = time.monotonic() <= end
        rec["sink_settled"] = (alive is False and self.thread_started is True and not self.errors
                               and self.construction_error is None and rec["fifo_same_inode_still_fifo"] is True
                               and rec["buffer_rehash_matches"] is True and self.reader_fd_closed is True
                               and self.unblock_fd_closed is True and rec["finish_deadline_in_bounds"] is True)
        self.finished = rec                      # failed/live result is frozen: no second join or close attempt
        if rec["sink_settled"] is not True:
            latch("proof buffer integrity/closure unproven: " + self.fifo_path)
        return rec

    def release(self):
        """Drop only the ended collector's RAM reference; unknown endpoints remain separately inventoried."""
        self.release_requested = True
        if self.thread is not None and self.thread.is_alive():
            return False
        self.released = True
        self.blocks = ()
        return True

    def holders(self):
        return [f.label for f in list(LIVE_FEEDERS) if f.blocks and self.frozen_id is not None
                and id(f.blocks) == self.frozen_id]

    def accounting(self):
        return {"fifo": self.fifo_path, "retained": self.retained, "released": self.released,
                "release_requested": self.release_requested,
                "collector_alive": self.thread is not None and self.thread.is_alive(),
                "thread_constructed": self.thread is not None, "thread_started": self.thread_started,
                "construction_error": self.construction_error, "error": self.error, "errors": list(self.errors),
                "reader_fd": self.reader_fd, "reader_fd_identity": self.reader_fd_identity,
                "reader_fd_closed": self.reader_fd_closed, "reader_close_attempted": self.reader_close_attempted,
                "reader_close_error": self.reader_close_error,
                "unblock_fd": self.unblock_fd, "unblock_fd_identity": self.unblock_fd_identity,
                "unblock_fd_closed": self.unblock_fd_closed, "unblock_close_attempted": self.unblock_close_attempted,
                "unblock_close_error": self.unblock_close_error, "unblock_open_attempts": self.unblock_open_attempts,
                "finish_started": self.finish_started, "finish_deadline": self.finish_deadline,
                "still_held_by_feeders": self.holders(), "frozen": self.frozen_id is not None,
                "finished": self.finished}

    def census_paths(self):
        return {self.fifo_path}

    def census_refusals(self, snap):
        v = snap.get(self.fifo_path)
        return [] if v is not None and v[0] == "fifo" and list(v[1:3]) == self.fifo_identity else ["proof FIFO identity drift"]

    def late_obligations(self):
        return [{"path": self.fifo_path, "kind": "fifo", "note": "native writer or runner collector may retain endpoint"},
                {"what": "RAM collector blocks", "bytes_known": self.retained, "note": "runner resources until exit"},
                {"what": "RAM collector descriptors", "reader_fd": self.reader_fd,
                 "reader_fd_identity": self.reader_fd_identity, "reader_fd_closed": self.reader_fd_closed,
                 "reader_close_attempted": self.reader_close_attempted, "reader_close_error": self.reader_close_error,
                 "unblock_fd": self.unblock_fd, "unblock_fd_identity": self.unblock_fd_identity,
                 "unblock_fd_closed": self.unblock_fd_closed, "unblock_close_attempted": self.unblock_close_attempted,
                 "unblock_close_error": self.unblock_close_error, "errors": list(self.errors),
                 "note": "unknown close outcomes retain original descriptor identity; no retry on a possibly reused fd"}]
P.Feeder:
class Feeder:
    """One owned pipe writer. Descriptor numbers survive unknown close outcomes; only affirmative
    os.close completion clears rfd/wfd. Source deadlines bound joins, not synchronous OS-call latency."""

    def __init__(self, blocks, mode="plain", label=""):
        if mode not in ("plain", "suffix", "hold"):
            raise RuntimeError("unknown feed mode %r" % (mode,))
        if not isinstance(blocks, tuple):
            raise RuntimeError("proof buffer not frozen")
        self.blocks = blocks
        self.mode, self.label = mode, label
        self.expected = 0
        self.sha = self.hold = self.thread = None
        self.fed = self.proof_fed = 0
        self.delivery_error = self.exception = self.construction_error = None
        self.errors = []
        self.close_errors = []
        self.hold_released_by_event = None
        self.started = self.start_attempted = self.start_completed = False
        self.start_acquisition_unknown = False
        self.pipe_acquisition_started = self.pipe_acquisition_completed = self.pipe_acquisition_unknown = False
        self.rfd = self.wfd = None
        self.read_endpoint_identity = self.write_endpoint_identity = None
        self.read_endpoint_acquired = self.write_endpoint_acquired = False
        self.read_endpoint_closed = self.write_endpoint_closed = True  # no endpoint acquired yet
        self.read_close_attempted = self.write_close_attempted = False
        self.read_close_fd = self.write_close_fd = None
        self.read_close_error = self.write_close_error = None
        self.abandon_error = None
        self.finished = None
        self.finish_started = False
        self.finish_deadline = None
        LIVE_FEEDERS.append(self)                 # complete inspectable state before Event/Thread/pipe acquisition
        try:
            self.expected = sum(len(b) for b in blocks)
            self.sha = hashlib.sha256()
            self.hold = threading.Event()
            self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
            self.pipe_acquisition_started = True
            self.rfd, self.wfd = os.pipe()
            self.read_endpoint_identity, self.write_endpoint_identity = self.rfd, self.wfd
            self.read_endpoint_acquired = self.write_endpoint_acquired = True
            self.read_endpoint_closed = self.write_endpoint_closed = False
            self.pipe_acquisition_completed = True
        except BaseException as exc:
            if self.pipe_acquisition_started and not self.pipe_acquisition_completed:
                self.pipe_acquisition_unknown = True
                self.read_endpoint_closed = self.write_endpoint_closed = None
            self.construction_error = repr(exc)
            self._error("construction", exc)
            try:
                self.abandon()
            except BaseException as cleanup_exc:
                self._error("construction rollback", cleanup_exc)
            latch("feeder construction unproven %r" % (exc,))
            raise

    @property
    def close_error(self):
        return "; ".join(self.close_errors) if self.close_errors else None

    def _error(self, what, exc):
        self.errors.append("%s: %r" % (what, exc))

    def _close_endpoint(self, name, propagate=False):
        side = "read" if name == "rfd" else "write"
        closed_key, attempted_key = side + "_endpoint_closed", side + "_close_attempted"
        error_key = side + "_close_error"
        if getattr(self, attempted_key):
            prior = getattr(self, error_key)
            if prior is not None and propagate:
                raise RuntimeError(prior)         # uncertain descriptor may have been reused: never retry it
            return prior
        fd = getattr(self, name)
        if fd is None:
            if getattr(self, closed_key) is True:
                return None
            prior = getattr(self, error_key)
            if prior is None:
                prior = side + " endpoint identity unavailable before closure"
                setattr(self, error_key, prior)
                self.close_errors.append(prior)
                self.errors.append(prior)
            setattr(self, closed_key, None)
            if propagate:
                raise RuntimeError(prior)
            return prior
        setattr(self, attempted_key, True)
        setattr(self, side + "_close_fd", fd)
        try:
            os.close(fd)
        except BaseException as exc:
            message = "%s endpoint closure uncertain: %r" % (side, exc)
            setattr(self, closed_key, None)
            setattr(self, error_key, message)
            self.close_errors.append(message)
            self.errors.append(message)
            if propagate:
                raise
            return message
        else:
            setattr(self, closed_key, True)
            setattr(self, name, None)
            return None

    def plan(self):
        return {"mode": self.mode, "buffer_bytes": self.expected, "blocks": len(self.blocks)}

    def close_read(self):
        return self._close_endpoint("rfd", propagate=True)

    def start(self):
        if self.start_attempted or self.finished is not None or self.construction_error is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("feeder start is not an unused, constructed acquisition")
        self.start_attempted = True
        try:
            self.thread.start()
            self.start_completed = True
        except BaseException as exc:
            if self.exception is None:
                self.exception = repr(exc)
            self._error("start", exc)
            self.start_acquisition_unknown = self.thread is None or self.thread.ident is None
            raise
        finally:
            self.started = self.thread is not None and self.thread.ident is not None

    def abandon(self):
        """Only a proven never-started writer can be abandoned. Each acquired endpoint gets at most
        one close attempt; repeated calls return existing faults without retrying uncertain fd numbers."""
        if self.started or self.start_acquisition_unknown or (self.thread is not None and self.thread.ident is not None):
            if self.abandon_error is None:
                self.abandon_error = "abandon: feeder is started or thread launch state is unproven"
                self.errors.append(self.abandon_error)
            return list(self.close_errors) + [self.abandon_error]
        self._close_endpoint("rfd")
        self._close_endpoint("wfd")
        self.blocks = ()
        return list(self.close_errors)

    def _deliver(self, data):
        mv, off = memoryview(data), 0
        while off < len(mv):
            try:
                n = os.write(self.wfd, mv[off:off + WRITE_SLICE])
            except OSError as exc:
                self.delivery_error = "%s after %d fed bytes" % (
                    "EPIPE" if isinstance(exc, BrokenPipeError) else repr(exc), self.fed)
                return off, False
            if type(n) is not int or n <= 0 or n > len(mv) - off:
                raise OSError(errno.EIO, "feeder write made no valid progress")
            self.sha.update(mv[off:off + n])
            off += n
            self.fed += n
        return off, True

    def _run(self):
        self.started = True
        try:
            if self.mode == "hold":
                self.hold_released_by_event = self.hold.wait(HOLD_SECONDS)
                if self.hold_released_by_event is not True:
                    raise RuntimeError("held feed event allowance exhausted")
            ok = True
            for b in self.blocks:
                k, ok = self._deliver(b)
                self.proof_fed += k
                if not ok:
                    break
            if ok and self.mode == "suffix":
                self._deliver(SUFFIX)
        except BaseException as exc:
            if self.exception is None:
                self.exception = repr(exc)
            self._error("writer", exc)
        finally:
            self._close_endpoint("wfd")          # EOF only after one affirmative close; failure retains identity

    def finish(self, timeout):
        """After checker reap, release the hold and perform one bounded join. Cache failed/live receipts too."""
        if self.finished is not None:
            return self.finished
        self.finish_started = True
        end = work_deadline(max(0.0, timeout))
        self.finish_deadline = end
        alive = None
        try:
            if self.started or (self.thread is not None and self.thread.ident is not None):
                self.hold.set()
                self.thread.join(max(0.0, min(STREAM_JOIN, end - time.monotonic())))
            elif not self.start_acquisition_unknown:
                self.abandon()
            alive = None if self.start_acquisition_unknown else self.thread is not None and self.thread.is_alive()
            if time.monotonic() > end:
                raise RuntimeError("feeder cleanup allowance exhausted")
        except BaseException as exc:
            if self.exception is None:
                self.exception = repr(exc)
            self._error("finish", exc)
        if alive is False:
            self.blocks = ()
        self.finished = {"mode": self.mode, "started": self.started, "buffer_bytes": self.expected,
                         "fed_bytes": self.fed, "fed_sha256": None if self.sha is None else self.sha.hexdigest(),
                         "proof_bytes_fed": self.proof_fed, "undelivered_proof_bytes": self.expected - self.proof_fed,
                         "delivery_error": self.delivery_error, "exception": self.exception,
                         "close_error": self.close_error, "close_errors": list(self.close_errors), "errors": list(self.errors),
                         "hold_released_by_event": self.hold_released_by_event, "thread_alive_after_join": alive,
                         "construction_error": self.construction_error,
                         "read_endpoint": self.rfd, "write_endpoint": self.wfd,
                         "read_endpoint_identity": self.read_endpoint_identity,
                         "write_endpoint_identity": self.write_endpoint_identity,
                         "read_endpoint_acquired": self.read_endpoint_acquired,
                         "write_endpoint_acquired": self.write_endpoint_acquired,
                         "read_endpoint_closed": self.read_endpoint_closed,
                         "write_endpoint_closed": self.write_endpoint_closed,
                         "read_close_attempted": self.read_close_attempted, "write_close_attempted": self.write_close_attempted,
                         "read_close_fd": self.read_close_fd, "write_close_fd": self.write_close_fd,
                         "read_close_error": self.read_close_error, "write_close_error": self.write_close_error,
                         "pipe_acquisition_started": self.pipe_acquisition_started,
                         "pipe_acquisition_completed": self.pipe_acquisition_completed,
                         "pipe_acquisition_unknown": self.pipe_acquisition_unknown,
                         "start_attempted": self.start_attempted, "start_completed": self.start_completed,
                         "start_acquisition_unknown": self.start_acquisition_unknown,
                         "finish_deadline_in_bounds": time.monotonic() <= end}
        return self.finished

    def accounting(self):
        alive = None if self.start_acquisition_unknown else self.thread is not None and self.thread.is_alive()
        unresolved = (alive is not False or bool(self.blocks) or self.read_endpoint_closed is not True
                      or self.write_endpoint_closed is not True or self.rfd is not None or self.wfd is not None
                      or self.construction_error is not None or bool(self.errors)
                      or self.pipe_acquisition_unknown or self.start_acquisition_unknown
                      or (self.finished is not None and self.finished.get("finish_deadline_in_bounds") is not True))
        return {"label": self.label, "mode": self.mode, "started": self.started,
                "thread_alive": alive, "retained_bytes": self.expected if self.blocks else 0,
                "read_endpoint": self.rfd, "write_endpoint": self.wfd,
                "read_endpoint_identity": self.read_endpoint_identity, "write_endpoint_identity": self.write_endpoint_identity,
                "read_endpoint_closed": self.read_endpoint_closed, "write_endpoint_closed": self.write_endpoint_closed,
                "read_close_attempted": self.read_close_attempted, "write_close_attempted": self.write_close_attempted,
                "read_close_fd": self.read_close_fd, "write_close_fd": self.write_close_fd,
                "read_close_error": self.read_close_error, "write_close_error": self.write_close_error,
                "close_error": self.close_error, "close_errors": list(self.close_errors), "errors": list(self.errors),
                "construction_error": self.construction_error, "exception": self.exception,
                "pipe_acquisition_unknown": self.pipe_acquisition_unknown,
                "start_acquisition_unknown": self.start_acquisition_unknown,
                "finish_started": self.finish_started, "finish_deadline": self.finish_deadline,
                "finished": self.finished, "unresolved": unresolved}

    def late_obligations(self):
        return [{"what": "runner-owned stdin feeder", "label": self.label, "state": self.accounting(),
                 "note": "retain pipe identities, uncertain closure history and any held RAM until parent disposition"}]
P.buffer_integrity:
def buffer_integrity(rec):
    if not isinstance(rec, dict):
        return False
    if any(k not in rec or rec[k] is not None for k in
           ("error", "construction_error", "reader_close_error", "unblock_close_error")) or rec.get("errors") != []:
        return False
    required_true = ("sink_settled", "thread_started", "fifo_same_inode_still_fifo", "reader_fd_closed", "unblock_fd_closed",
                     "buffer_rehash_matches", "finish_deadline_in_bounds")
    return (all(rec.get(k) is True for k in required_true)
            and rec.get("thread_alive_after_join") is False and rec.get("error") is None
            and rec.get("construction_error") is None and _hex64(rec.get("sha256_of_retained"))
            and all(type(rec.get(k)) is int and rec[k] >= 0 for k in ("received", "retained", "discarded", "cap"))
            and rec["retained"] <= rec["cap"] and rec["received"] == rec["retained"] + rec["discarded"]
            and rec.get("buffer_rehash") == [rec["sha256_of_retained"], rec["retained"]])

def census_refusals(self, snapshot):
        """Growth is allowed only for the retained, singly-linked proof inode at its exact settled size."""
        why = []
        if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
            return ["proof sink census is not a complete snapshot mapping"]
        if self.construction_error is not None:
            why.append("proof sink construction failed: " + self.construction_error)
        fifo = snapshot.get(self.fifo_path)
        if not isinstance(fifo, (tuple, list)) or len(fifo) != 9 or fifo[0] != "fifo" \
                or self.fifo_identity is None or list(fifo[1:3]) != self.fifo_identity:
            why.append("proof FIFO census identity/kind mismatch: " + self.fifo_path)
        proof = snapshot.get(self.file_path)
        if not isinstance(proof, (tuple, list)) or len(proof) != 9 or proof[0] != "file" \
                or self.file_identity is None or list(proof[1:3]) != self.file_identity:
            why.append("proof file census identity/kind mismatch: " + self.file_path)
        else:
            if proof[7] != 1:
                why.append("proof file census link count is not one: " + self.file_path)
            if not isinstance(proof[3], int) or isinstance(proof[3], bool) or proof[3] != self.written \
                    or not isinstance(self.cap, int) or isinstance(self.cap, bool) or not 0 <= proof[3] <= self.cap:
                why.append("proof file census size does not equal written within cap: " + self.file_path)
        return why
